# Version 4.155.0
> **Skia m155 preview** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews the Skia m155 engine with current servicing fixes. It also updates HarfBuzzSharp, improves GLES interop signatures, and disables unsupported RAW and DNG image decoding.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m155** — Moves the bundled renderer to m155 and incorporates the current upstream Chrome and servicing fixes. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081), [#5196](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5196), [#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## API Surface

- **GLES interop uses pointer-based signatures** — Updates the native GLES interop declarations to use pointer-based signatures, matching the underlying API more accurately. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))

## Bug Fixes

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — Disables unsupported RAW and DNG image decoding paths in the bundled renderer. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

Updates the bundled HarfBuzzSharp native library to version 14.4.0.
